title: Platform authorization created [beta]
description: This event occurs when a platform authorization is created. This event includes a required `external_account_id` field.

clearing_type.title: Clearing type
clearing_type.description: Type of clearing used for this authorization. Online for authorizations that create instant transactions, offline for authorizations that create transactions from confirmation.

code.title: New authorization code
code.description: Alphanumeric 6-digit ID for the new authorization.

contract_amount.title: Contract amount
contract_amount.description: Calculated authorization amount with taxes or fees in the account's currency.

event_datetime.title: Event datetime
event_datetime.description: Event timestamp in the UTC format (RFC 3339).

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: Custom account ID used to identify the account within your organization. This value links the Pismo account to your internal account identifier. This field is a key that links a Pismo account to your account ID.

installment_amount.title: Installment amount
installment_amount.description: Installment amount of the authorization. If the authorization does not have more than one installment, the value of this field is the same as `principal_amount`.

original_authorization_datetime.title: Original authorization datetime
original_authorization_datetime.description: Date and time of the original authorization in UTC-0 (RFC3339) format, which includes milliseconds (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ). For events with the AUTHORIZATION category, this field will always have the same value as `event_datetime`.

original_authorization_id.title: Original authorization ID
original_authorization_id.description: Pismo ID that represents the original authorization. For events with the AUTHORIZATION category, this field will always have the same value as `authorization_id`.

principal_amount.title: Principal amount
principal_amount.description: Calculated amount of the authorization without taxes or fees in the account's currency.

processing_code.title: Processing code
processing_code.description: Processing code provided for the authorization.

response_code.title: Response code
response_code.description: Response code assigned to the new authorization. Indicates successful authorization or reasons for authorization denial.

tracking_id.title: Tracking ID
tracking_id.description: Tracking ID provided by the client for the new authorization.

validation_results.title: Validation results
validation_results.description: All executed validations with details for each result. For a complete documentation of all the possible validations, see Authorization validation rules for platform operations

account_currency.title: Account currency
account_currency.description: ISO-4217 alphabetic code of the account's currency of the authorization. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

account_currency_num_code.title: Account currency
account_currency_num_code.description: ISO-4217 numeric code (3 digits) for authorization account's currency. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Pismo ID for the account associated with the authorization. In the absence of the field you see 0.

beneficiary_id.title: Beneficiary ID
beneficiary_id.description: ID for the beneficiary related to the account. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

caller.title: Caller
caller.description: Identification of the caller from which the request was originated. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

cancellation_reason.title: Cancellation reason
cancellation_reason.description: Reason for the cancellation. Supported value is AUTHORIZATION CONFIRMATION TIMEOUT. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

card_id.title: Card ID
card_id.description: Pismo ID for the card associated with the authorization. In the absence of the field you see 0.

customer_id.title: Customer ID
customer_id.description: Pismo ID of the customer associated with the account. In the absence of the field you see 0.

denial_code.title: Denial code
denial_code.description: Code generated for denied authorizations, which indicates the reason the request was denied. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

description.title: Authorization description
description.description: Description provided for the authorization. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

entry_mode.title: Entry mode
entry_mode.description: Entry mode of the authorization. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

installments_details.title: Installments details
installments_details.description: Detailed information for all the installments of the authorization.

ledger_id.title: Ledger ID
ledger_id.description: Pismo ID of the ledger indicating the account limit impact. This field may be empty since some authorizations don't have any financial impact. You can see the same information in the `ledger_updates` array. In the future, this field will be discontinued. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

ledger_impact.title: Ledger impact
ledger_impact.description: Limits that were impacted by the ledger during the authorization. You can see the same information in the `ledger_updates` array. In the future, this field will be discontinued.

ledger_update_datetime.title: Ledger update datetime
ledger_update_datetime.description: Date and time of the exact moment of impact on ledger in UTC-0 (RFC3339) format, which includes milliseconds (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ). This field may be empty since some authorizations don't have any financial impact. You can see the same information in the `ledger_updates` array. In the future, this field will be discontinued. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

ledger_updates.title: Ledger updates
ledger_updates.description: Detailed information for all ledger updates, which indicate impact of this authorization on account limits.

local_currency.title: Local currency
local_currency.description: ISO-4217 alphabetic code of the local currency of the authorization. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

local_currency_num_code.title: Local currency
local_currency_num_code.description: ISO-4217 numeric code (3 digits) for local authorization's currency. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

marketplace_id.title: Marketplace ID
marketplace_id.description: ID of the marketplace associated with the merchant. In the absence of the field you see 0.

merchant.title: Merchant details for the authorization
merchant.description: Object containing additional merchant data, if applicable.

city.title: Merchant city
city.description: City where the merchant is located, supplied during authorization creation. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

country.title: Merchant country
country.description: Country where the merchant is located, supplied during authorization creation. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

id.title: External merchant ID
id.description: Client-provided external merchant ID, supplied during authorization creation. This value may differ from the internal merchant ID. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

marketplace_id.title: External marketplace ID
marketplace_id.description: Client-provided external marketplace ID associated with the merchant, supplied during authorization creation. This value may differ from the internal marketplace ID. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

name.title: Merchant name
name.description: Name of the merchant associated with the authorization, supplied during authorization creation. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

terminal_id.title: Merchant terminal ID
terminal_id.description: ID of the terminal used by the merchant, supplied during authorization creation.

merchant_id.title: Merchant ID
merchant_id.description: ID of the merchant associated with the authorization. In the absence of the field you see 0.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Any additional information relevant to the caller

nsu.title: NSU
nsu.description: Message initiator ID that uniquely identifies an authorization. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

number_of_installments.title: Number of installments
number_of_installments.description: Number of installments in the authorization. In the absence of the field you see 0.

org_operation_id.title: Org operation ID
org_operation_id.description: For Pismo internal processing only. In the absence of the field you see 0.

original_authorization_confirmed.title: Original authorization confirmed flag
original_authorization_confirmed.description: Defines whether the original authorization has been confirmed already.

payment_datetime.title: Payment datetime
payment_datetime.description: Date and time of the authorized payment in UTC-0 (RFC3339) format, which includes milliseconds (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ). In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

posting_date.title: Posting date
posting_date.description: Date of the statement when the authorization will be posted. The format is yyyy-mm-dd (RFC 3339). In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

pre_authorization.title: Pre-authorization flag
pre_authorization.description: Defines whether this authorization request is a pre-authorization or not.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Pismo ID for the program associated with the account. In the absence of the field you see 0.

raw_message.title: Raw message
raw_message.description: Metadata provided by applications that integrate with the platform authorization. This field is different from the 'metadata' field, which contains custom information provided by the customer.

related_accounts.title: Related accounts
related_accounts.description: Parent accounts used during the authorization with shared limits.

request_id.title: Request ID
request_id.description: Unique identifier of the request that originated the authorization. This field is omitted from the payload when it is not present.

statement_id.title: Statement ID
statement_id.description: Pismo ID for the statement when the authorization will be posted. In the absence of the field you see 0.

tid.title: Transaction ID
tid.description: External transaction ID received with the authorization message. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

type.title: Authorization type
type.description: Type of the authorization. Indicates if this is a normal authorization, a pre-authorization, a cancellation, or a confirmation.

validation_result.title: Validation result
validation_result.description: Executed validation with details for its result.

examples: The processing code was not found.
The authorization passed flex control evaluation.
There was an internal error creating the authorization.

additional_data.title: Additional data
additional_data.description: Contains additional information that is relevant to identify how the validation was performed. Every type of validation has its own additional data.

additional_financial_details.title: Additional financial details
additional_financial_details.description: Additional information related to the authorization.

annual_interest_rate.title: Annual interest rate
annual_interest_rate.description: Percentage of interest charged over the course of a year. In the absence of the field you see 0.

effective_annual_cost.title: Effective annual cost
effective_annual_cost.description: Total annual finance charge expressed as a percentage rate.

effective_monthly_cost.title: Effective monthly cost
effective_monthly_cost.description: Total monthly finance charge expressed as a percentage rate.

rates.title: Rates
rates.description: Authorization rates used to calculate taxes and fees present on postings object.

authorization_validations.title: Authorization validations
authorization_validations.description: Contains additional data to be used in the authorization flow.

is_device_registered.title: Device registration status
is_device_registered.description: Indicates whether the device used for the operation is registered according to the financial institution's security policies.

associated_ids.title: Associated IDs
associated_ids.description: External IDs used in the authorization flow.

origin_id.title: Origin ID
origin_id.description: External ID of the origin of the authorization. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

payment_id.title: Payment ID
payment_id.description: External ID associated with the authorization. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

installment_detail.title: Installment detail
installment_detail.description: Detailed information for a given installment.

number.title: Sequential number of installment
number.description: Sequential number of the current installment.

principal_amount.title: Principal amount
principal_amount.description: Principal amount of the current installment.

related_accounts.title: Related accounts
related_accounts.description: This object lists all related accounts in this authorization that have a common shared limit.

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: ID of the account returned when searching the account hierarchy.

is_centralizer.title: Is centralizer
is_centralizer.description: Is this the centralizing account within the hierarchy? The centralizing account groups the debits of the accounts within the hierarchy.

level.title: Level
level.description: Numeric level in the hierarchy when compared to the account used in this authorization.

parent_account_id.title: Parent account ID
parent_account_id.description: ID of the parent account of the account returned in the object.

currency_numeric_code.title: Currency numeric code
currency_numeric_code.description: Account's currency ISO-4217 numeric code (3 digits)

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Pismo ID for the program associated with the account. In the absence of the field you see 0.

ledger_update.title: Ledger update
ledger_update.description: Detailed information for a ledger impact.

id.title: Ledger ID
id.description: Pismo ID of the ledger indicating the account limit impact. This field may be empty since some authorizations don't have any financial impact. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.

impact.title: Ledger impact
impact.description: Limits that were impacted by the ledger during the authorization.

update_datetime.title: Ledger update datetime
update_datetime.description: Date and time of the exact moment of impact on ledger in UTC-0 (RFC3339) format, which includes milliseconds (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ). This field may be empty since some authorizations don't have any financial impact. In the absence of the field you see an empty string.
